what.text: This page follows refugees from Pakistan living in Thailand, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1182 Pakistani refugees in Thailand, 1.3% of all refugees from Pakistan.
Afghanistan hosts the most Pakistani refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Italy and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan in every year from 2007 to 2025, with the TTP and Lashkar-e-Islam among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in periods from 2004 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2003 at 5 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 2075, at the end of 2017; the main years of displacement in the data are 2016 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Thailand.
These are year-end totals for Thailand only, reported to UNHCR.
